=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15715-15740 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: test_stall_judge_diagnostics_report_merged_linked_pr_and_keep_escalation expects the #9482 notice "Stall judge action 'escalate_human' kept for issue #823: linked PR #825 is merged". The fixture's default base is orchestrator/project-768, so the earlier #9481 branch (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23037-23040, helper 24664-24692) handles the case first with reason merged_non_target_base and prints "STALL_RECOVERY issue=823 reason=judge_escalate_kept linked_pr=merged_non_target_base ...". The elif at 23049-23053 is never reached.
  WHY: CI on head 018085ec fails tests-system-python (7) and orchestrate-poll shard 2 at line 15740, and the lint gate fails as a result, so the PR cannot merge. The runtime keep behaviour is correct; only the expected log line is wrong. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15769 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: test_stall_judge_escalation_not_kept_for_closed_non_implementation_cross_ref expects "normalized to 'attempt_merge'" and no ai:needs-human label. For any closed unmerged PR, _stall_judge_linked_pr_keeps_escalation returns 0 with reason closed_unmerged (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24679-24681) and never consults _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr. The escalation is therefore kept, the notice at 23093-23094 never prints, and the issue gets ai:needs-human.
  WHY: CI on head 018085ec fails tests-system-python (8) and orchestrate-poll shard 3 at line 15769. There are two fixes. Fix (a) rewrites the test to expect "reason=judge_escalate_kept linked_pr=closed_unmerged"; it is conservative and keeps #9481. Fix (b) adds a separate `&& _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` line in the caller between 23037 and 23038. sonnet prefers (a). Both reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23037-23053 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The pre-existing #9481 keep branch (23037-23040, with helper 24674-24681) keeps escalate_human for any closed-unmerged PR, or any PR merged into a non-target base, without checking whether it is the issue's implementation PR. It runs before the new #9482 elif, so the elif's _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr guard at 23049-23051 is never evaluated for closed PRs or for the acceptance-test fixtures.
  WHY: A closed mention-only cross-reference gets ai:needs-human instead of being normalised to attempt_merge, which contradicts the test's intent and the changelog. The two acceptance tests fail in CI as a result. The reviewers disagree on severity: minimax rated it BLOCKER and luna rated it MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- agents.d/9482-standalone-stall-merged-linked-pr.md:2 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The agents.d fragment says "a closed mention-only cross-reference keeps the old normalisation". The changelog.d/9482-standalone-stall-merged-linked-pr.md line 8 bullet says "a closed mention-only cross-reference does not count". At runtime, the #9481 branch (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23037-23040, 24679-24681) keeps escalate_human for every closed-unmerged PR, so such issues get ai:needs-human.
  WHY: The operator documentation and release notes describe the opposite of what the poller does, and the failing test at line 15769 shows the divergence. If fix (a) is chosen, reword both fragments. If fix (b) is chosen, the current text becomes accurate. All three reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19291-19298 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: _standalone_state_trusted_login refreshes the login only when UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN is empty and UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN_STATE is "unset". After one failed lookup it never retries.
  WHY: The current flow mitigates this, because run_standalone_stall_recovery calls unblock_trusted_login directly. The risk is that a future caller could permanently disable AI_STANDALONE_STALL_STATE_V1 parsing until the process restarts. Rated NIT. sonnet and glm rejected the claim: the memoisation mirrors unblock_trusted_login (4425-4440), the poller runs per tick, and the fail-closed skip is the intended #9718 behaviour.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add tests using the #823 / #825 shape (merged into `orchestrator/project-*`, issue standalone)" for "Do not normalize a judge `escalate_human` to `attempt_merge` when the linked PR is not open." test_stall_judge_diagnostics_report_merged_linked_pr_and_keep_escalation is listed as a red-on-base acceptance test.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, test_stall_judge_diagnostics_report_merged_linked_pr_and_keep_escalation and test_stall_judge_escalation_not_kept_for_closed_non_implementation_cross_ref
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: Both tests fail on head 018085ec (system-Python shards 7 and 8, orchestrate-poll shards 2 and 3). No passing test covers the notice path of the #9482 elif. The runtime keep behaviour exists, through #9481 for integration-branch merges and the #9482 elif for target-base merges.
- requirement: "Do not normalize a judge `escalate_human` to `attempt_merge` when the linked PR is not open. … A closed mention-only cross-reference does not count." (issue #9482, "Proposed fix" bullet 3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh invoke_stall_judge escalation-keep guard (around 23027-23053), with verifiable tests in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both new acceptance tests fail in CI because the #9481 _stall_judge_linked_pr_keeps_escalation branch keeps the escalation before the elif's _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr check can run. The behaviour "closed mention-only cross-reference does not count" is neither exercised nor enforced on HEAD; the deliverable is only partly implemented.
- requirement: README.md documentation for the second exception to `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION` (escalate_human is kept when the issue's own implementation PR is closed or merged)
  expected_change_site: README.md orchestrate_poll env table and defaults table for `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff has no README.md edits. The reviewer itself says this is "not a gap per the rules": issue #9482 does not require it, the judges deferred it as a follow-up, and README.md is outside files_touched. Rated NIT. sonnet, gemini and glm also treat it as deferred.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15740 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: test_stall_judge_diagnostics_report_merged_linked_pr_and_keep_escalation uses the default base orchestrator/project-768. The #9481 branch (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23037-23040, helper 24664-24692) returns merged_non_target_base (line 24690) before the #9482 elif at 23049-23053, so the "kept ... is merged" notice never appears.
  WHY: CI on 018085ec fails tests-system-python (7) and orchestrate-poll shard 2, and the lint gate then fails. Suggested fix: assert "STALL_RECOVERY issue=823 reason=judge_escalate_kept linked_pr=merged_non_target_base pr=825", and add a sibling call with baseRefName "main" and ENABLE_STALL_MERGED_PR_GUARD=false that asserts the notice.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15769 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: test_stall_judge_escalation_not_kept_for_closed_non_implementation_cross_ref fails because the helper returns closed_unmerged for any closed PR (24679-24681) without checking _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr. The escalation is kept, the notice at 23093-23094 does not print, and ai:needs-human is applied.
  WHY: CI fails tests-system-python (8) and orchestrate-poll shard 3. Fix (a), test-only, expects "linked_pr=closed_unmerged". Fix (b) inserts a separate `&& _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr "${issue_num}" "${linked_pr_json}" \` line between 23037 and 23038 in the caller, not in the helper. The reviewer prefers (a).
- agents.d/9482-standalone-stall-merged-linked-pr.md:2 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fragment, and changelog.d/9482-standalone-stall-merged-linked-pr.md line 8, claims a closed mention-only cross-reference keeps the old normalisation. On the current tree, #9481 keeps escalate_human for every closed-unmerged PR and every PR merged into a non-target base.
  WHY: The operator docs and release notes describe the opposite of runtime behaviour. Reword the fragments if fix (a) is chosen.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Add tests using the #823 / #825 shape (merged into `orchestrator/project-*`, issue standalone)"; acceptance test test_stall_judge_diagnostics_report_merged_linked_pr_and_keep_escalation | Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py (both tests) | Evidence of absence: both tests fail on 018085ec (shards 7/8, orchestrate-poll 2/3), and no passing test covers the #9482 elif notice path | SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py next to the merged-PR test. Add a call with baseRefName "main" and ENABLE_STALL_MERGED_PR_GUARD=false, assert the "kept for issue #823: linked PR #825 is merged" notice, and assert that "reason=judge_escalate_kept" is absent. About 10 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Notes (2 related items): The reviewer rejected minimax's empty-payload fail-open claim (23896-23898, 23050) and its _standalone_state_trusted_login no-retry claim (4425-4440, intended #9718 behaviour). It reported no README gap because that work is deferred and outside files_touched, and found that the last autofix run introduced no new defects.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The new #9482 elif is unreachable in the acceptance-test scenarios. The #9481 _stall_judge_linked_pr_keeps_escalation branch (23027-23036) returns 0 first with merged_non_target_base or closed_unmerged, so the _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr guard at line 23051 is never evaluated.
  WHY: CI on 018085ec fails tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15740 and tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15769 (shards 7/8, orchestrate-poll 2/3). Either tighten #9481 to gate on _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr, or rewrite the tests and add a `main` baseRefName fixture.
